Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE complete polished 16:9 landscape character-selection game screen, 1920x1080 target, full bleed, no device frame, no variant headings outside game, not a collage. This is a design proposal for an existing Chinese match-3 deckbuilding game.
Input images roles: 1 existing main menu STYLE reference (paper theater, plum, cream, gold); 2 prior character selection COMPOSITION reference; 3-5 EXACT CHARACTER IDENTITY references in order Coletta, Phoebe, Sigrika; for Chisaki use black bob hair and red eyes from the third slot of image 2. Preserve these chibi HEAD-ONLY sticker designs with white contour, especially Coletta white hair, red black ribbons, cyan/pink eyes; do not invent bodies or substitute new characters.
Maintain existing runtime layout using normalized bounds: left information x .12-.40 y .16-.70; large head portrait on RIGHT x .48-.88 y .11-.66; bottom navigation x .045-.955 y .75-.89. Background framing can extend beyond these bounds. Leave generous safe margins. Do not move selector into sidebar or place it above character. Exactly FOUR character slots, left to right Coletta selected, Phoebe greyed, Chisaki greyed, Sigrika greyed. Gold selected outline. Show small readable '待开放' under disabled portraits. Bottom order '返回', left chevron, four portraits, right chevron, '开始探索'. Start is the primary action; back secondary. All seven total characters are represented through paging; only four visible. No currencies, rarity stars, currencies shop, levels badges, equipment or invented features.
Chinese text verbatim, sharp legible well aligned: name '柯莱塔'; status '冷凝 · 可探索'; description '以冷凝技能牌消耗消除积累的资源。'; two short stats '基础生命 60' and '基础攻击 6'; growth '每级攻击 +1，生命上限 +5'; deck heading '初始牌组 · 10 张'; four compact entries '碎晶弹 ×4', '护身晶幕 ×3', '交错射击 ×2', '晶簇狙击 ×1'; attribute selector '选择属性球（4 / 4）' with FOUR neat icons snowflake, flame, lightning, wind and corresponding labels '冷凝', '热熔', '导电', '气动'. Do not render large card faces; keep left information compact within allocated space. Hierarchy prioritizes character name, stats, deck list, attribute control. Avoid tiny text, excessive ornate borders or background noise under text. No explanatory annotations. Variant art direction A: refined PAPER THEATER, strongest continuity with the existing main menu. Muted burgundy and plum cut-paper curtains framing upper corners, just a few hanging gold stars, low-contrast purple paper bushes and cream fantasy stage. Left is one vertical warm ivory paper ticket dossier, clean thin gold outline and restrained burgundy name tab. Four deck names as orderly text rows with no card art. Right Coletta head floats above a shallow warm cream paper stage with soft contact shadow, plenty of quiet dark purple negative space. Bottom controls rest on an ivory strip with subtle cut corners. Burgundy and gold start ticket, plum back ticket. Elegant, charming, handcrafted matte paper materials. More usable and restrained than the old reference; no oversized ornate banner. Preserve exact fixed layout.
